**Cephalexin does not have a direct, dangerous interaction with alcohol, nor does alcohol stop the antibiotic from working** . However, ` [Highlight start] drinking alcohol while taking cephalexin is generally discouraged because it can worsen side effects and slow your recovery [Highlight end] ` . As noted by the [NHS](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF17LpPPlletGMxMe1YH5CyFZSini6Pkv-OOVc1ix2qC879xdRhaiTXCwCfJWAERhyQ_ahIQG8szfO3rFqqOeH5kZmoHtlwd_qeaNlM46-uZv3KQq5qeBDXStvt1H1OhrS9gdRsv8tnrH6hcXCIjU724qLi0qztyp-sgr7VWB54Q) , drinking alcohol is permitted with cefalexin, though clinicians often recommend avoiding it until you feel better.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF17LpPPlletGMxMe1YH5CyFZSini6Pkv-OOVc1ix2qC879xdRhaiTXCwCfJWAERhyQ_ahIQG8szfO3rFqqOeH5kZmoHtlwd_qeaNlM46-uZv3KQq5qeBDXStvt1H1OhrS9gdRsv8tnrH6hcXCIjU724qLi0qztyp-sgr7VWB54Q)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXNQkJ69DL4-m9M64FI_-yL7SFbuh9TRzJIw9nAmWXD3r4LkTFDODqQJ_K7pSvdK62BtCHXQj-VlNMVukRGGHp6WrFpMBgRVDE8031_REBCm18Sghx7D2Ek9xMUM75kr1mD6wFRLV8d7ON_6pOpEh9vKemyC_SQUfmYQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF1-Ff8_1LIXCBB2j1oCIpwf7TvtZJzjP_Vk1nknVc1VyW8tnaJzqs4lj0Nm1TzPWoedZp_fepZT3faJd2HTjo6RRwS6kFW-UozBSjtB-Dx2_gDLiQAOYDpUx-gDS1vaQrq5udzkRG27L2k9bBVpPcCktMQJ0SQXmu_DO5nXhm1jANEPGCywyF6jUZiHArXvUVNA)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXX9FtIM6kUZO76uFB9yVnx21q1S65p-LxEI4rnJ2X74ni307A2Kqm09Yh6UYjklq4KLhAY2bC1ao2vRH69lTikk0tKBDNoGHHsfU5CqlMVMOMR9qfezc6tvK5hPwBtLuQwm1G6z_WlFe7BPWaz6j2PJhMlo5RouWMAttw)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXOGf7TpSAIgXLnNk3eYlOJtcG8fYuU-u6bQun5wMfb7-njBIjp3bI6c38UPynBLN_fKhvZQBIdsc1sU3CsxCDbXKmlOAXcHub5iqgGUm5i4IJRMnLPphjSENRj7nYOw9COZeBfA)

### Why Doctors Often Recommend Avoiding Alcohol

- **Worsened side effects:** Both cephalexin and alcohol can cause nausea, stomach upset, vomiting, diarrhea, and dizziness. Combining them can make these symptoms stronger.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXOGf7TpSAIgXLnNk3eYlOJtcG8fYuU-u6bQun5wMfb7-njBIjp3bI6c38UPynBLN_fKhvZQBIdsc1sU3CsxCDbXKmlOAXcHub5iqgGUm5i4IJRMnLPphjSENRj7nYOw9COZeBfA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF1-Ff8_1LIXCBB2j1oCIpwf7TvtZJzjP_Vk1nknVc1VyW8tnaJzqs4lj0Nm1TzPWoedZp_fepZT3faJd2HTjo6RRwS6kFW-UozBSjtB-Dx2_gDLiQAOYDpUx-gDS1vaQrq5udzkRG27L2k9bBVpPcCktMQJ0SQXmu_DO5nXhm1jANEPGCywyF6jUZiHArXvUVNA)
- **Slower recovery:** Alcohol can disrupt sleep, cause dehydration, and temporarily weaken your immune response while your body is fighting an infection. For urinary tract infections (UTIs), alcohol may also irritate the bladder.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXTCM-fke0tCL0lehePQLGZ7CrCSVI8q0DDt17eFS7wwAO4FtPUqrwdDQ0M8fJBDEZkE5BNs18gTsgxaz9PYnZ_CU3fQ4x7y7dfFzERVonzsotDYhFu_1KCrFm3RHULYwNEvVpKn_I)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXOGf7TpSAIgXLnNk3eYlOJtcG8fYuU-u6bQun5wMfb7-njBIjp3bI6c38UPynBLN_fKhvZQBIdsc1sU3CsxCDbXKmlOAXcHub5iqgGUm5i4IJRMnLPphjSENRj7nYOw9COZeBfA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF1-Ff8_1LIXCBB2j1oCIpwf7TvtZJzjP_Vk1nknVc1VyW8tnaJzqs4lj0Nm1TzPWoedZp_fepZT3faJd2HTjo6RRwS6kFW-UozBSjtB-Dx2_gDLiQAOYDpUx-gDS1vaQrq5udzkRG27L2k9bBVpPcCktMQJ0SQXmu_DO5nXhm1jANEPGCywyF6jUZiHArXvUVNA)
- **Harder to track symptoms:** Hangovers or alcohol-related side effects can mimic or mask infection symptoms or medication reactions.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXNQkJ69DL4-m9M64FI_-yL7SFbuh9TRzJIw9nAmWXD3r4LkTFDODqQJ_K7pSvdK62BtCHXQj-VlNMVukRGGHp6WrFpMBgRVDE8031_REBCm18Sghx7D2Ek9xMUM75kr1mD6wFRLV8d7ON_6pOpEh9vKemyC_SQUfmYQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF1-Ff8_1LIXCBB2j1oCIpwf7TvtZJzjP_Vk1nknVc1VyW8tnaJzqs4lj0Nm1TzPWoedZp_fepZT3faJd2HTjo6RRwS6kFW-UozBSjtB-Dx2_gDLiQAOYDpUx-gDS1vaQrq5udzkRG27L2k9bBVpPcCktMQJ0SQXmu_DO5nXhm1jANEPGCywyF6jUZiHArXvUVNA)
- **Missed doses:** Drinking can make it easier to forget a scheduled dose of your antibiotic.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXNQkJ69DL4-m9M64FI_-yL7SFbuh9TRzJIw9nAmWXD3r4LkTFDODqQJ_K7pSvdK62BtCHXQj-VlNMVukRGGHp6WrFpMBgRVDE8031_REBCm18Sghx7D2Ek9xMUM75kr1mD6wFRLV8d7ON_6pOpEh9vKemyC_SQUfmYQ)

### Important Caveats

- **Disulfiram-like reactions:** Certain other cephalosporin antibiotics (such as cefotetan or cefoperazone) can cause a severe reaction—flushing, fast heartbeat, nausea, and low blood pressure—when mixed with alcohol. While cephalexin is not typically linked to this reaction, it belongs to the same antibiotic class.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF1-Ff8_1LIXCBB2j1oCIpwf7TvtZJzjP_Vk1nknVc1VyW8tnaJzqs4lj0Nm1TzPWoedZp_fepZT3faJd2HTjo6RRwS6kFW-UozBSjtB-Dx2_gDLiQAOYDpUx-gDS1vaQrq5udzkRG27L2k9bBVpPcCktMQJ0SQXmu_DO5nXhm1jANEPGCywyF6jUZiHArXvUVNA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXOGf7TpSAIgXLnNk3eYlOJtcG8fYuU-u6bQun5wMfb7-njBIjp3bI6c38UPynBLN_fKhvZQBIdsc1sU3CsxCDbXKmlOAXcHub5iqgGUm5i4IJRMnLPphjSENRj7nYOw9COZeBfA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXX666tBWH4Nj5LGn933pbSkS87dcT4wFkqf9eUrfa6Y8vgpan6OschgkCM6l_x0MmN6fq0xT4MD4poVnmBFCXazXoizBd1VrYqyaamPedFjbYSmmfFPQ6_TqD0916boBjgDl_Pv8clOw)
- **Kidney function and other medications:** Your kidneys clear cephalexin from your body, and your overall health or other prescriptions may change how you tolerate alcohol. A breakdown of alcohol and antibiotic interactions is available in Fact versus Fiction: a Review of the Evidence behind Alcohol and Antibiotic Interactions , and further context on drinking patterns is covered by [Rehab 4 Alcoholism](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXNQkJ69DL4-m9M64FI_-yL7SFbuh9TRzJIw9nAmWXD3r4LkTFDODqQJ_K7pSvdK62BtCHXQj-VlNMVukRGGHp6WrFpMBgRVDE8031_REBCm18Sghx7D2Ek9xMUM75kr1mD6wFRLV8d7ON_6pOpEh9vKemyC_SQUfmYQ).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXOGf7TpSAIgXLnNk3eYlOJtcG8fYuU-u6bQun5wMfb7-njBIjp3bI6c38UPynBLN_fKhvZQBIdsc1sU3CsxCDbXKmlOAXcHub5iqgGUm5i4IJRMnLPphjSENRj7nYOw9COZeBfA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF1-Ff8_1LIXCBB2j1oCIpwf7TvtZJzjP_Vk1nknVc1VyW8tnaJzqs4lj0Nm1TzPWoedZp_fepZT3faJd2HTjo6RRwS6kFW-UozBSjtB-Dx2_gDLiQAOYDpUx-gDS1vaQrq5udzkRG27L2k9bBVpPcCktMQJ0SQXmu_DO5nXhm1jANEPGCywyF6jUZiHArXvUVNA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXGw7BS9vxrfHADDQIECh6RSshTBT9ROlDdsp_nsz9t8tq6rCSEyXnrVSEhi05BYGQeXJYAUBDh29__IaRrI4hvl2_HD0WA9sXMDPj_Rd9Q_lWGeTJxnnH0GdU07UO5MDK0txuaM3Vkw)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXNQkJ69DL4-m9M64FI_-yL7SFbuh9TRzJIw9nAmWXD3r4LkTFDODqQJ_K7pSvdK62BtCHXQj-VlNMVukRGGHp6WrFpMBgRVDE8031_REBCm18Sghx7D2Ek9xMUM75kr1mD6wFRLV8d7ON_6pOpEh9vKemyC_SQUfmYQ)

A breakdown of alcohol and antibiotic interactions is available in Fact versus Fiction: a Review of the Evidence behind Alcohol and Antibiotic Interactions , and further context on drinking patterns is covered by [Rehab 4 Alcoholism](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXNQkJ69DL4-m9M64FI_-yL7SFbuh9TRzJIw9nAmWXD3r4LkTFDODqQJ_K7pSvdK62BtCHXQj-VlNMVukRGGHp6WrFpMBgRVDE8031_REBCm18Sghx7D2Ek9xMUM75kr1mD6wFRLV8d7ON_6pOpEh9vKemyC_SQUfmYQ).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXOGf7TpSAIgXLnNk3eYlOJtcG8fYuU-u6bQun5wMfb7-njBIjp3bI6c38UPynBLN_fKhvZQBIdsc1sU3CsxCDbXKmlOAXcHub5iqgGUm5i4IJRMnLPphjSENRj7nYOw9COZeBfA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF1-Ff8_1LIXCBB2j1oCIpwf7TvtZJzjP_Vk1nknVc1VyW8tnaJzqs4lj0Nm1TzPWoedZp_fepZT3faJd2HTjo6RRwS6kFW-UozBSjtB-Dx2_gDLiQAOYDpUx-gDS1vaQrq5udzkRG27L2k9bBVpPcCktMQJ0SQXmu_DO5nXhm1jANEPGCywyF6jUZiHArXvUVNA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXGw7BS9vxrfHADDQIECh6RSshTBT9ROlDdsp_nsz9t8tq6rCSEyXnrVSEhi05BYGQeXJYAUBDh29__IaRrI4hvl2_HD0WA9sXMDPj_Rd9Q_lWGeTJxnnH0GdU07UO5MDK0txuaM3Vkw)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXNQkJ69DL4-m9M64FI_-yL7SFbuh9TRzJIw9nAmWXD3r4LkTFDODqQJ_K7pSvdK62BtCHXQj-VlNMVukRGGHp6WrFpMBgRVDE8031_REBCm18Sghx7D2Ek9xMUM75kr1mD6wFRLV8d7ON_6pOpEh9vKemyC_SQUfmYQ)
